mapper.select: SELECT request_id, request_hash, adjustment_status AS status, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY request_id) AS applied_count, MAX(applied_at) OVER (PARTITION BY request_id) AS applied_at FROM inventory_demo_adjustment WHERE request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY inventory_demo_adjustment_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT request_id) FROM inventory_demo_adjustment WHERE requested_by = #{requestedBy} AND requested_at >= #{since} AND adjustment_status = 'APPLIED'
SELECT MAX(applied_at) FROM inventory_demo_adjustment WHERE requested_by = #{requestedBy} AND adjustment_status = 'APPLIED'
SELECT 1 FROM inventory_source_state WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} FOR UPDATE WAIT 5

choose.when: INSERT INTO inventory_demo_adjustment ( request_id, request_hash, source_type, source_record_key, decrease_qty, source_row_version_before, source_row_version_after, source_hash_before, source_hash_after, adjustment_status, requested_by, requested_at, applied_at, payload_json ) SELECT #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, #{sourceType}, src.source_record_key, #{decreaseQty}, src.row_version, src.row_version + 1, src.record_hash, LOWER(RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH( src.source_record_key || '|' || TO_CHAR(src.available_stock_count - #{decreaseQty}, 'TM9', 'NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS = ''.,''') || '|' || TO_CHAR(src.row_version + 1), 'SHA256' ))), 'APPLIED', #{requestedBy}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, JSON_OBJECT( 'sourceType' VALUE #{sourceType}, 'sourceRecordKey' VALUE src.source_record_key, 'decreaseQty' VALUE #{decreaseQty} RETURNING CLOB ) FROM inventory_source_offline src WHERE src.active_yn = 'Y' AND src.is_deleted = 0 AND src.available_stock_count >= #{decreaseQty} AND src.record_hash = src.synced_record_hash
